title: Civil engineering draftsperson
abstract: Skilled Civil drafter with Residential and Commercial experience for growing engineering consultancy.
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a civil drafter?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
How many years' experience do you have as a Civil Design Draftsperson?
content_text:
About the role
Join NOTAZ International, a growing Australian engineering consultancy with over 25 years of experience in the steel, mining, mineral processing, energy, and infrastructure sectors. The position of a skilled and experienced Civil drafter with specialisation/experience in Residential and Commercial projects has become available. You will be part of a highly skilled multidisciplinary team delivering innovative engineering solutions for some of the most challenging industrial projects.
Key responsibilities
- Prepare single line diagrams, formulated tables in excel, sketches, charts, plans and designs for civil engineering works such as crossovers, driveways, stormwater systems, roads, etc.
- Prepare preliminary designs in 2D using hand sketches, PDF editors or AutoCAD
- Prepare concise engineering drawings from sketches and design information unassisted
- Comply with CAD Standards and Quality Systems relevant to specialization and location and apply techniques and procedures commonly used in that practice area and specialisation
- Undertake reviews of engineering drawings to ensure compliance with CAD standards and Quality Systems
- Manage and monitor the quality of work performed by others and promote a culture of technical excellence through mentoring and training less experienced drafters
- Fulfil Project Drafter role - manage the drafting aspects of projects of varying complexity and size, including planning and controlling of deliverables, resource management and maintaining communication between engineering and drafting staff on the project
- Place feature surveys onto drawings and understand site levels to ensure civil compliance
- Complete Sustainability Design Assessments such as STORM Reports
- Assist the office with printing and follow up phone calls to Councils, Consultants and Clients
About you
- Advanced Diploma or above in relevant field
- At least 3 years' experience as a Civil engineering draftsperson
- Experience in using Revit and AutoCAD to produce architectural and civil documents
- High degree of accuracy and attention to detail with excellent planning and organisation skills
- Well-developed understanding and appreciation of architecture and landscape architecture, and how these design disciplines impact technical civil engineering design considerations
- Experience working in a diverse range of projects big and small for all types of clients from small extensions to townhouse/apartment developments to schools, pavilions, and clubhouses
- Experience working autonomously
- Appropriate time management skills and flexibility to allow for the management of a varying workload
- Fantastic interpersonal skills
About us
NOTAZ International is a growing Australian engineering consultancy with over 25 years of experience in the steel, mining, mineral processing, energy, and infrastructure sectors. Since 1999, we have delivered engineering excellence across more than 180 industrial projects, working alongside leading global technology providers and supporting clients from concept through to project execution. We value technical excellence, collaboration, and practical thinking.
